description: Machine-readable manifest of Lido ecosystem tokens for automated integrators and AI agents. The deployed-contracts pages on docs.lido.fi are the source of truth for addresses; this file is validated against them on every build. Read https://docs.lido.fi/integrations/ai-agents before acting on this data.

tokens.name: Liquid staked Ether 2.0
quirks: balances change on oracle reports without Transfer events
an ERC-20 transfer can move 1-2 wei less than the requested amount
transferShares and transferSharesFrom move exact share amounts; transferSharesFrom spends token-denominated allowance
direct ETH staking is subject to an on-chain rate limit and can be paused

probes.expect: current stake limit in wei; read before staking

tokens.name: Wrapped liquid staked Ether 2.0
tokens.accounting: non-rebasing wrapper; one wei corresponds to one stETH share
quirks: the stETH value of one wstETH changes with protocol accounting; read the rate from the contract
accepts plain ETH through a payable shortcut that stakes with the zero referral address
cannot be unwrapped on networks where only bridged wstETH exists

probes.expect: current rate in 1e18 precision; do not cache

tokens.name: Lido DAO Token
quirks: transfer and transferFrom can return false instead of reverting; check the returned boolean
balanceOfAt and totalSupplyAt expose historical snapshots

tokens.name: Lido: stETH Withdrawal NFT
tokens.accounting: withdrawal request position; the NFT owner holds the claim right
quirks: requests cannot be canceled; the NFT is burned on claim
index BatchMetadataUpdate events so finalized requests update correctly
request size is bounded by on-chain MIN/MAX constants; read them from the contract

tokens.name: Lido Earn ETH
tokens.accounting: non-rebasing vault shares; asset value per share follows oracle reports
quirks: the token is the Vault's ShareManager; never use the Vault address as the ERC-20
deposits and redemptions go through registered queue contracts, never direct transfers
public burn and burnFrom destroy shares without returning assets
mint, burn, transfer, whitelist, and lockup controls are configurable; read flags()
asynchronous redemption requests cannot be canceled

probes.expect: current control flags; do not assume they are static
